newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola Enterprises holders approve split.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola Enterprises holders approve split.

text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc said shareholders at the annual meeting Monday approved a proposed three-for-one stock split.
The split will be effective for share owners of record on May 1 and will increase the company's shares outstanding to 378 million from about 126 million.

Shareholders also elected Jean-Claude Killy to the board of directors for a term expiring in 2000. Killy, 53, has been chairman and chief executive of the Company of the Tour de France (organizer and promoter of sporting events) since 1994, and chairman of Coca-Cola Enterprise S.A. (French Coca-Cola bottler) since 1993.
